content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-one-afternoon-fast|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe are restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-explained-digital-creators-5|selling]] their products online. This infrastructure problem hinders the growth of digital commerce, making it difficult for creators to reach their full potential. This post breaks down the solution, focusing on Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation, and how it enables seamless [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-12|Crypto Payment]] payments without relying on traditional platforms.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a powerful tool for automating digital commerce tasks, allowing creators to focus on producing high-quality content rather than managing complex payment systems. By leveraging Google Apps Script, digital creators can build a sovereign stack that processes orders in under 30 seconds, ensuring a seamless experience for their customers. This approach matters because it provides an alternative to traditional payment platforms, which are often restricted in certain regions or require cumbersome setup processes.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack relies on several key components, including Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook triggers the Google Apps Script, which then processes the order and sends a download link to the customer. This process is automated, ensuring that orders are fulfilled quickly and efficiently, without the need for manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who face restrictions when using traditional payment platforms. In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where Stripe and PayPal have limited functionality, creators can use Google Apps Script and NOWPayments to sell their digital products. This approach provides a level of infrastructure sovereignty, allowing creators to own and control their payment systems, rather than relying on third-party platforms.
Cloudflare Workers can handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work together seamlessly to provide a robust and efficient payment system. Cloudflare Workers, for example, can handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, making it an ideal choice for creators who need to process a high volume of transactions. By combining Google Apps Script, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can build a scalable and reliable payment system that meets their needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the right components, such as Google Apps Script and NOWPayments. They can then configure their stack to process orders automatically, using the NOWPayments webhook to trigger the Google Apps Script. With the right guidance and support, creators can have a fully functional payment system up and running in a matter of hours, rather than days or weeks.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by using a webhook to trigger the fulfillment process after a crypto payment confirms. This ensures that customers receive their products quickly and efficiently, without the need for manual intervention. By using a solution like NOWPayments, creators can automate their payment systems, providing a better experience for their customers and reducing the administrative burden of managing orders.

Next, they should test their stack to ensure that it is working correctly, and finally, they should deploy their stack and start selling their digital products. By following these steps, creators can have a fully functional payment system up and running in a matter of hours, rather than days or weeks.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a webhook and how does it work?

A webhook is a callback function that is triggered by a specific event, such as a payment confirmation. It works by sending a notification to a specified URL, which then triggers the fulfillment process.
Can I use Google Apps Script with other payment platforms?
Yes, Google Apps Script can be used with other payment platforms, but it is most commonly used with NOWPayments due to its ease of use and flexibility.
How do I configure my stack to process orders automatically?

To configure your stack to process orders automatically, you need to set up the NOWPayments webhook to trigger the Google Apps Script, which then processes the order and sends a download link to the customer.
